findings.entity: waitress (person count in sunlit wide shot)
findings.description: From 01:50 to 01:51.9 a single waitress is in frame wiping the counter. At ~01:52.2 a second, identically uniformed waitress appears at the rear-left end of the counter, emerging from the spot the first waitress just occupied, with no door entry or walk-in. Both are visible simultaneously through ~01:56, then the two figures converge and merge back into one by 01:57. Person count goes 1 -> 2 -> 1 with no visible entrance or exit.

At 01:12.5 two mugs are clearly visible side by side: the man's mug in his hand and a second mug the waitress has slid over from beside the plate. By 01:12.8 only a single mug remains, gripped by both the man's and the waitress's hands; no mug is lifted away or carried off, and only one mug persists through 01:14-01:17. The two mugs appear to merge into one.
